one_line: Ghurid commander whose swift campaigns toppled Sena rule in Bihar and Bengal around 1200 CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, lean but wiry build, about average height with the athletic frame of a cavalry commander.
appearance.face: Sharp oval face with a slightly prominent nose, medium-tan North Indian–Afghan complexion, faint scar along the left cheek, narrow dark brows, intense almond-shaped eyes with a hard, calculating gaze; default expression is a focused, slightly grim determination.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair worn to just above the shoulders, usually hidden under a dark, slightly conical quilted war cap wrapped with a deep-red cloth band and a short tail of fabric at the back, a few side-locks visible near the temples.
appearance.costume: Over a simple off‑white cotton tunic and narrow dark brown trousers, he wears a padded, knee-length quilted coat (kazaghand) in muted steel-grey stitched in vertical channels, belted with a plain dark leather girdle; a sleeveless mail shirt is suggested beneath at the collar, and a long dark-red woolen sash hangs from the belt; his footwear is mid‑calf brown leather riding boots; over one shoulder is a weathered, light-brown wool cloak for riding, fastened with a small metal clasp; minimal jewellery—just a plain iron ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged iron sabre with a plain steel crossguard, simple brown leather-wrapped hilt, and an unadorned brown leather scabbard slung from his belt on the left, always held or worn ready for cavalry action.

ref_desc: Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khalji is a lean, medium-tan cavalry commander with a sharp oval face, shoulder-length black hair under a dark quilted war cap, wearing an off‑white tunic, steel-grey quilted coat, dark trousers, brown riding boots, deep-red sash and cloak, and carrying a plain curved sabre in a brown leather scabbard, dominated by steel grey, deep red, brown leather, off‑white and dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khalji: a lean, medium-tan cavalry commander in his late 20s–30s with a sharp oval face, slightly prominent nose, intense almond-shaped dark eyes and a faint scar on his left cheek, expression focused and grim; his straight black hair is shoulder-length but mostly hidden under a dark, slightly conical quilted war cap wrapped with a deep-red cloth band and a short fabric tail, with small side-locks visible at the temples. He wears a modest off‑white cotton tunic and narrow dark brown trousers, over which sits a knee-length steel-grey quilted coat (kazaghand) stitched in vertical channels, hinting at a mail shirt beneath at the collar; a simple dark leather belt girds his waist with a long deep-red woolen sash hanging from it. Show mid‑calf brown leather riding boots, and a weathered light-brown wool cloak draped over one shoulder and fastened with a small metal clasp. Keep jewellery minimal, just a plain iron ring on his right hand. His signature weapon is a slightly curved iron sabre with a plain steel crossguard and brown leather-wrapped hilt in an unadorned brown leather scabbard hanging on his left hip; depict him holding or resting a hand on the sabre. Emphasize the colour palette of steel grey, deep red, brown leather, off‑white and dark brown, and present front, side and back views to clearly show face, hair, costume and weapon details in a clean, historically grounded shonen-anime style.
